name: Dollie AI – Connect
author: getdollie

sections.description:
Agencies have processes. Ways of working with clients. Preferences for how sites get built, maintained, and reported on. That context — who your clients are, what they care about, which sites they run — is what makes your agency yours.

The problem? Most AI tools don’t know any of that. They’re generic. They can explain how WordPress works, but they can’t actually do anything on your sites. And they certainly don’t know that Sarah prefers her reports on Monday mornings, or that Mike’s staging sites haven’t been updated in three weeks.

That’s what Dollie changes.

Dollie is your Agency HQ for the AI Era — a central place where all your agency knowledge connects to any AI tool. Clients, sites, preferences, project history. When that context lives in one place, AI stops being generic and starts being genuinely useful.

This plugin is the bridge. Install it on any WordPress site, hosted anywhere, and it becomes part of your agency brain.

AI That Actually Controls WordPress

Here’s the difference. Without Dollie, AI can explain wp_query syntax or write a code snippet for you to copy and paste. With Dollie, AI executes real operations on your actual sites:

  • Update plugins across your entire portfolio in natural language
  • Run security scans and get AI-drafted reports for clients
  • Create backups before making changes — automatically
  • Manage content, users, and settings without touching wp-admin
  • Monitor uptime, errors, and site health across all connected sites
  • Execute WP-CLI commands remotely through conversation

It’s the difference between AI that talks about WordPress and AI that works in WordPress.

Your Agency Brain. Any AI Tool.

Dollie doesn’t lock you into one interface. Once your sites are connected, your entire agency context is accessible from wherever you work:

  • Dollie Chat — Natural language, right in the dashboard. Ask questions, run operations, generate reports. No learning curve.
  • MCP — Connect Claude Desktop, VS Code, Cursor, or Claude Code. Your agency context follows you into your development tools.
  • API — Build custom applications, client portals, or internal tools on top of your agency intelligence.

Start with chat. Explore MCP when you’re ready. Build on the API if you need to. Same agency brain, different doors.

Deep WordPress Intelligence

This plugin comes bundled with the Dollie WordPress SDK — over 100 integrations with the plugins agencies use every day. Your AI tools don’t just see WordPress at the surface level. They understand what’s happening inside WooCommerce, Elementor, Gravity Forms, LearnDash, and everything in between.

E-commerce — WooCommerce, Easy Digital Downloads, WooCommerce Subscriptions, CartFlows
Page Builders — Elementor Pro, Beaver Builder, Divi Builder, Bricks Builder
Forms — Gravity Forms, WPForms, Contact Form 7, Fluent Forms, Ninja Forms, Formidable Forms
LMS — LearnDash, LifterLMS, LearnPress, Tutor LMS, Sensei LMS, MasterStudy LMS
Membership — MemberPress, Paid Memberships Pro, Restrict Content Pro, Ultimate Member
CRM & Marketing — FluentCRM, Groundhogg, Jetpack CRM, Mail Mint, Mailpoet
Community — BuddyBoss, BuddyPress, bbPress, PeepSo, wpForo
And 70+ more — From Advanced Custom Fields to WP Job Manager

Have proprietary plugins? The SDK is extensible. Build custom integrations for the tools unique to your agency.

Built for How Agencies Actually Work

Dollie natively understands agency relationships: Team, Clients, Sites. Connect a site, assign it to a client, and every AI interaction inherits the full context — who the client is, their preferences, their other sites, their history.

Ask “Which of Sarah’s sites need plugin updates?” and Dollie knows exactly who Sarah is and which sites belong to her. Ask “Generate this month’s reports for all clients” and every report is personalized with the right context.

That’s the difference between a generic tool and an agency headquarters.

Works on Any Host

This plugin connects your site to Dollie over a secure API. It works wherever WordPress runs — your own servers, WP Engine, Cloudways, SiteGround, Kinsta, or any other host. Your hosting choice stays yours. Dollie adds the intelligence layer on top.

Getting Started

  1. Sign up for free at getdollie.com
  2. Install this plugin on your WordPress site
  3. Connect the site from your Dollie dashboard
  4. Start a conversation — ask your agent to check site health or generate a report

Your agency context is now connected.
sections.installation:
From the WordPress Plugin Directory

  1. Go to Plugins > Add New in your WordPress admin
  2. Search for Dollie AI – Connect
  3. Click Install Now, then Activate
  4. Follow the connection prompt to link your site to Dollie

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin zip file
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin
  3. Upload the zip file and click Install Now
  4. Activate the plugin
  5. Follow the connection prompt to link your site to Dollie

Requirements

  • WordPress 5.6 or higher
  • PHP 7.4 or higher
  • A Dollie account (sign up free)
sections.faq:
What is Dollie?

Dollie is your Agency HQ for the AI Era — a platform where all your agency knowledge (clients, sites, preferences, processes) connects to any AI tool. Think of it as the central brain for your agency that makes every AI tool you use smarter about your specific work.

Does this work with any hosting provider?

Yes. The plugin connects to Dollie over a secure API. It works on any host where WordPress runs — shared hosting, VPS, managed hosts, or your own servers. Your hosting choice is yours. Dollie adds AI-powered management on top.

What can AI actually do on my site?

Once connected, AI can execute real operations: update plugins and themes, create backups, run security scans, manage content and users, execute WP-CLI commands, and monitor site health. These are actual operations, not just explanations or code snippets.

Is my site safe?

All communication is encrypted and authenticated using secure tokens. No passwords are stored or transmitted. Every operation is logged with a full audit trail. You maintain full control and can disconnect your site at any time.

Can AI make changes without my approval?

You and your team control what happens. Operations are always initiated by a person — through Dollie’s chat, MCP tools, or API. Critical changes include safety checks, and every action is logged so you always know what happened and when.

Does this affect my site’s performance?

No. The plugin is lightweight and only communicates with Dollie when operations are requested. It adds no overhead to your front-end performance.

Can I install this on all my client sites?

That’s exactly what it’s built for. Install the plugin across your portfolio, connect each site to Dollie, assign them to clients, and manage everything from one place. The more sites you connect, the more useful your agency brain becomes.

What happens if I deactivate the plugin?

Your site continues to work normally. It simply disconnects from Dollie. Reactivate anytime to reconnect.

What AI tools does this work with?

Dollie works with any AI tool. Use the built-in chat interface, connect Claude Desktop or VS Code via MCP, or build custom applications using the OpenAI-compatible API. Same data, same capabilities, whichever tool you prefer.

Do you support multisite?

The plugin can be installed on individual sites within a WordPress multisite network.
